subject: Proposal: 2-year committed plan — banded annualization & risk-adjusted credit
messages:
From: Sarah Kapoor <sarah.kapoor@greentechlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@greentechlabs.com, Michael Anders <michael.anders@greentechlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pricing for 2yr committed plan (ramp / credits)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost profile. We
are evaluating a 2-year committed purchase to standardize inference for our product lines. A few
questions before we loop procurement: 

- Can you confirm a target discount band for a 2-year prepay that covers ~750k token units/month
  in year 1 ramping to ~2.2M token units/month by year 2?
- We have seasonality and would like a banded annualization (true-up window + capped variance).
- Payment preference is annual invoice up front; would Redwood offer graduated credits if we
  frontload payment?

Also copying procurement to surface any standard evidence they need for finance. Looking for a
formal offer and MMP (mutual action plan) we can review with our legal team.

Best,
Sarah Kapoor
Director, Platform Engineering
GreenTech Labs

PS — if it helps, our CFO Michael will want a clear escrow/true-up protection and an option to
reduce committed units by up to 15% at annual reset if utilization materially misses forecast.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kapoor <sarah.kapoor@greentechlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing for 2yr committed plan (ramp / credits)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear notes and the heads up about the CFO requirements. Happy to
outline a concise offer and MMP. High level here so we can align internally on the exact wording:

- Proposed discount: 15–20% off list for a 24-month prepay, banded by committed token tiers.
- Ramp protection: tiered true-up window with a 10% variance floor and a one-time annual adjust
  up to 15% at reset (to address Michael's concern).
- Frontload incentive: additional 3% credit applied to the first-year invoice if paid annual up
  front within 30 days of signature.

I’ll pull together a pricing grid and a draft MMP and loop in finance for sign-off on the credit
language. Ben / Karthik — can you help finalize the discount bands and confirm whether we can
stretch to 18% on committed ARR if we include a 30-day payment clause and an escalator tied to
usage?

Sarah — I’ll aim to get a formal PDF and DocuSign link by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: GreenTech 2yr — discount/credit approval request (pricing grid attached)

Folks — chasing approval for the attached draft. Customer asks: 2yr prepay, year-1 ramp, annual
true-up with ability to reduce by up to 15% at reset. My suggested structure (see pricing-grid.xlsx):

- Commit levels: Bronze 9–500k/mo, Silver 500k–1.5M/mo, Gold 1.5M–3M/mo. GreenTech expects to
  move from Silver -> Gold by end of year 2.
- Discount bands (proposed): Bronze 12%, Silver 15%, Gold 18% off list.
- Frontload credit: 3% extra applied to invoice when customer prepays annually (within 30d).
- Risk-adjusted clause: If utilization is <85% of forecast for any given year, a one-time true-up
  credit applies (capped at 20% of that year's invoice).
- Escalator: If usage exceeds committed tier by >25% sustained for 2 months, price steps to next
  tier with no penalty.

Marcus — need finance to confirm the credit cap and cashflow impact. Karthik / Ben — any legal
concerns on the escalation language? We also have to be explicit about model-variant fallbacks if
capacity changes.

Attachments: pricing-grid.xlsx, GT-Redwood-2yr-Offer.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx

Thanks,
Marissa

On Sun, May 24, 2026 at 11:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear notes... (see thread)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: GreenTech 2yr — discount/credit approval request (pricing grid attached)

Marissa — finance ok with the high-level structure provided we: 

- Keep the 3% frontload credit but apply it only if the invoice clears within 30 days and is not
  subject to a net-90 hold.
- Cap the annual true-up credit at 18% of the invoiced year (slightly lower than proposed) to
  control downside.
- Require a simple SLA exit clause for material underuse (we can allow the 15% annual reset but
  not multiple reductions in a 12-month window).

If Ben / Karthik confirm acceptance of those constraints, I can sign off and we can send the
formal offer.

—Marcus
Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kapoor <sarah.kapoor@greentechlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@greentechlabs.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood final offer: GreenTech Labs — 24 month committed plan (DocuSign)

Hi Sarah — following internal approvals, please find our formal offer attached and the DocuSign
link below to execute. Summary of the agreed points: 

- Term: 24 months, annual prepay invoiced at start of each 12-month period.
- Commit & discount: Silver -> Gold banding (GreenTech qualifies for a blended 17% discount
  on year-1 committed ARR, stepping to 18% in year-2 if usage meets forecast).
- Frontload credit: 3% credit applied to first-year invoice once payment clears within 30 days.
- True-up protection: annual adjustment window; utilization reductions up to 15% allowed at
  annual reset; true-up credit cap set at 18% of the invoice for the underused year.
- Escalator & capacity: sustained >25% overage for 2 months triggers tier reprice to next
  commitment level.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/GT-5234-offer
Attachments: GT-Redwood-2yr-Offer.pdf, pricing-grid.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.docx

Once signed, we will set a kickoff MMP session and provision the dedicated GPU pool for the
Gold tier as the usage steps up. Let me know if you'd like a short call to review the SOW.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood final offer: GreenTech Labs — 24 month committed plan (DocuSign)

Sarah — attaching the signed-off PDF (GT-Redwood-2yr-Offer.pdf) for your legal review. The
DocuSign link above is live; feel free to route to procurement and legal. Key next steps after
signature:

1) We issue the annual invoice and apply the 3% frontload credit once payment clears.
2) Schedule MMP kickoff (30–45 minutes) to align on onboarding and usage monitoring.
3) Quarterly check-ins in the first year to validate ramp assumptions and apply any true-ups.

If GreenTech wants an explicit clause for a single mid-term adjustment (outside the annual reset)
we can discuss separately but that would need to be scoped into the SOW.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
